artifacts.notes: Complete provider PDF retained byte-for-byte; possession of all 343 PDF pages does not establish that every original leaf survives or that the whole book has been read. Registration inspection is bounded to PDF pages 6, 8–9, 17–20 and 339, using page rasters. Latin title/imprint, patriarchal prescription and the editorial revision account were read directly; the native title leaf was visually inspected without a complete diplomatic transcription. The PDF's page order is the provider's order and differs from printed pagination and right-to-left reading order. No checked liturgical transcription or complete collation is registered by this acquisition.
artifacts.rights_basis: Historical 1922 printing, public domain in the United States by expired publication term. ULB Bonn identifies this exact digitized item with Public Domain Mark 1.0 at https://digitale-sammlungen.ulb.uni-bonn.de/content/titleinfo/3097402 (License/Rightsstatement, checked 2026-10-16), linking https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/mark/1.0/. The mark records a public-domain assessment, not a new copyright licence. The retained artifact is the library's mechanical reproduction of the historical pages, including its identification cover. No modern critical edition or translation is imported. These source bytes are not offered under Triptych's CC BY 4.0 licence.

edition.authority: Ignatius Ephrem II Rahmani, Patriarch of Antioch of the Syrians, addresses the patriarchate at printed pp. 3–4 (PDF pages 8–9). His decree, dated Beirut, 8 December 1922, prescribes this edition alone as authentic throughout his patriarchate and wherever its rite is observed. This is a historical prescription, not a claim of present-day authorization.
edition.publication: Typis Patriarchalibus in Seminario Sciarfensi de Monte Libano, 1922.

work.description: The Syriac Catholic celebrant's Eucharistic book, represented here by the patriarchal Sharfeh edition of 1922. It is a separate intellectual book from the auxiliary diaconicon represented by the Mosul 1881 witness registered under the stable legacy work ID work.syriac-catholic-church.missale.
